title: 8 Best Webflow Alternatives in 2026
summary: Webflow updated pricing in May 2026 with changes taking effect June 29. Here are 8 alternatives — from AI-first app builders like Blink to design tools like Framer and Wix Studio.
body_markdown: They serve fundamentally different needs. Webflow is a visual website builder — excellent for marketing sites, editorial content, and CMS-driven pages.[Blink](https://blink.new/) is an AI full-stack app builder that generates a real backend, database, and authentication system alongside the frontend. If you need users to log in, store data, or interact with business logic, Blink is the right tool. If you're building a company website or blog, Webflow or Framer is more appropriate.
